publications.title: ACE-272: A Retrospective Benchmark of Enterprise Trust Risks in Language-Model Endpoints
publications.abstract: A historical retrospective 272-case cohort across nine language-model endpoints and six enterprise trust domains; not a current 350-case benchmark, with preregistered dual-rater agreement pending and explicit scope, scoring, and attribution limits.

publications.title: ACE Benchmark v1.1 Technical Whitepaper
publications.abstract: The frozen technical record of the June 2026 ACE benchmark round, including methodology, scoring, results, and representative cases.
